beats.headline: Five in a gold box
beats.text: In a tutorial guild after the Hoarder, Carl opens his last three boxes. The gold crowd control box holds his kneepads, three scrolls, and five Potions of Iron Skin. Each raises his physical armour by a hundred percent for five minutes. The kneepads are the real prize; the potions go into his inventory.

beats.headline: The blast on his thigh
beats.text: Rot stickers swarm the walls and ceilings, little black raviolis that stick to you and explode like a sledgehammer. Donut is quick enough on Carl's shoulder that none have reached her, but just in case, he makes her drink one of his Iron Skin potions and drinks one himself. A rot sticker lands on his inner thigh and detonates before he can get it, and that time he does fall down. Without the potion, his leg might have been blown clear off. A well-timed missile from Donut saves him.

beats.headline: Drunk on the way out
beats.text: With Frank and Maggie able to go completely stealth, Carl and Donut jump out of the safe room and make for the closest main artery. Carl downs an Iron Skin potion and makes Donut drink one. The hallway is too thin and bumpy for the chopper, and one rot sticker blast could turn the bike into a bomb, so they run.
